summary: Both editions were reviewed independently against all nine paragraphs of the selected Greek. Each preserves the suffering list, bare Name, right/left distinction, equal gifts and promises, definite cleansing promise and negative qualification, speakers and seating, six builders, stone descriptions and actions, and final inability despite desire. The bracketed pronoun remains distinguished from unqualified preserved text. The notes accurately disclose the supplied reports’ relevant alternatives, corrections, gaps, and mediated versional evidence without replacing the working readings or harmonizing witnesses. No concrete fidelity defect was identified. Acceptance is limited to the supplied source and reported evidence; it does not authenticate unseen prints, manuscript images, handwriting, archived history, or an exhaustive collation.
